task: Pass the handoff context to the next agent in the pipeline before this agent's session ends. Token budget is critically constrained.

candidate_memories.content: Before ending this agent session, write a handoff record to the shared-state store with: completed_steps (list), current_artifact_path, next_step_description, and blocking_issues. The next agent will not have access to this session's context and will fail if the handoff record is missing or incomplete.
Handoff record format is defined in agent_protocol/handoff_schema.json; validate before writing.
All multi-agent pipelines must have a handoff record between every agent boundary; loss of handoff data is the primary cause of pipeline failures.
